crossRefs.note: A certain man of the sons of the prophets said to his fellow by Yahweh’s word, “Please strike me!” The man refused to…
“One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death,

translations.web: Then he found another man, and said, “Please strike me.” The man struck him and wounded him.
translations.bsb: Then the prophet found another man and said, “Strike me, please!” So the man struck him and wounded him,
translations.kjv: Then he found another man, and said, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man smote him, so that in smiting he wounded him.
translations.asv: Then he found another man, and said, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man smote him, smiting and wounding him.
